BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p196/r4.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p196/r4.speaker: author
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p196/r4.claim: The two verses address different cases, not abrogation: fidya applies to those described as yutīqūnahu, while the sick or traveler makes up missed days after the excuse ends.
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p196/r4.anchor: الآيتين المختلف على القول بالنسخ فيهما تشرعان لحالين مختلفتين: الفدية على من يطيقونه

BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p196/r5.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p196/r5.speaker: author
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p196/r5.claim: A person who breaks the fast for illness or travel must make up the missed days after the excuse passes; fidya is not accepted as a substitute for that make-up fast.
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p196/r5.anchor: وفي مثل هذا لا تقبل الفدية بديلاً من القضاء

BURHAN:v1p253#2/r2.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p253#2/r2.speaker: الكسائي
BURHAN:v1p253#2/r2.claim: Al-Kisa'i counts four verses beginning with the letter shin and names them: “Month of Ramadan,” “God bears witness,” “grateful for His favor,” and “He prescribed for you of religion.”
BURHAN:v1p253#2/r2.anchor: وسئل الكسائى كم فى القرآن آية أولها شين

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p172/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p172/r4.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p172/r4.claim: The month is a time span marked by the moon's first concealment through its disappearance and renewed appearance; it is named for its public visibility and people's need for it.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p172/r4.anchor: وهو: المدة الزمانية التي يكون مبدؤ الهلال فيها خافيا إلى أن يستسر

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p172/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p172/r5.speaker: الزجاج
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p172/r5.claim: Al-Zajjaj defines الشهر as the new moon; a poetic comparison to a fingernail supports its small, visible appearance.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p172/r5.anchor: وقال الزجاج: الشهر الهلال. قال. والشهر مثل قلامة الظفر

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r1.claim: An old Arabic poem uses ناتق as a pre-Islamic name for Ramadan and depicts its warriors leaving the battlefield.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r1.anchor: وفي ناتق أحلت لدى حرمة الوغى ... وولت على الأدبار فرسان خثعما

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r2.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r2.claim: The author objects to deriving Ramadan as a verbal noun from burning: this pattern is not a regular verbal noun of an intransitive verb, so treating the name as independently coined is preferable.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r2.anchor: ويحتاج في تحقيق أنه مصدر إلى صحة نقل لأن فعلانا ليس مصدر فعل اللازم

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r3.speaker: الزمخشري
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r3.claim: Al-Zamakhshari derives رمضان as a verbal noun from burning in the intense heat; the author objects that this pattern is not a regular verbal noun of an intransitive verb and prefers treating it as an independent name.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r3.anchor: وقال الزمخشري: الرمضان، مصدر رمض إذا احترق من الرمضاء

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r4.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r4.claim: A further proposed source is الرمض, a rain before autumn that cleans dust from the earth.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r4.anchor: وقيل: هو مشتق من الرمض، وهو مطر يأتي قبل الخريف

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r5.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r5.claim: القرآن is originally a verbal noun of قرأ, later used for the revealed book by naming the object through its source; with hamza it can mean gathering, while the unhamzated form may reflect transfer and deletion or a root meaning joining.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r5.anchor: القرآن: مصدر قرأ قرآنا. قال حسان، رضي الله عنه

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r6.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r6.claim: The author rejects deriving Qur'an from gathering water in a basin because that verb belongs to a different root-pattern.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r6.anchor: ومن زعم من: قريت الماء في الحوض، أي: جمعته، فقوله فاسد لاختلاف المادتين

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r8.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r8.claim: اليسر means ease, while يسر may also mean becoming wealthy and الميسر denotes gambling; the left hand is named optimistically or because it assists the right.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p173/r8.anchor: اليسر: السهولة، يسر: سهل، ويسر: سهل، وأيسر: استغنى

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p174/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p174/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p174/r1.claim: العسر means hardship or constriction, and الإكمال means completion.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p174/r1.anchor: العسر: الصعوبة والضيق، ومنه أعسر إعسارا

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p180/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p180/r8.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p180/r8.claim: The majority's view that the days are Ramadan is stronger: the next verse explicitly identifies Ramadan, and the unspecified prescription can cover any duration before being clarified.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p180/r8.anchor: وأكثر المحققين على أن المراد بالأيام: شهر رمضان

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p180/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p180/r9.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p180/r9.claim: The author answers the objections by reading the earlier hadith as abrogating prior-scriptural or earlier communal fasts and the repeated sick/traveler rule as clarification after residents' choice was replaced by a binding fast.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p180/r9.anchor: وأما الخبر فيمكن أن يحمل على نسخ كل صوم وجب في الشرائع المتقدمة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p180/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p180/r10.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p180/r10.claim: Whichever interpretation is adopted, some abrogation is required; the text's recitation order does not prove its revelation order.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p180/r10.anchor: والاتصال في التلاوة لا يوجب الاتصال في النزول

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p188/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p188/r6.speaker: معاذ بن جبل وابن عمر وسلمة بن الأكوع والحسن البصري والشعبي وعكرمة وابن شهاب والضحاك
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p188/r6.claim: Most exegetes say residents able to fast were initially free to fast or feed a poor person, then that option was abrogated by the command to fast when Ramadan is present.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p188/r6.anchor: كان الصيام على المقيمين القادرين مخيرا فيه، فمن شاء صام ومن شاء أفطر وأطعم

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p189/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p189/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p189/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas offers a view that those who can fast despite an illness may choose to fast or feed, but that concession was later abrogated except for those incapable.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p189/r2.anchor: قاله ابن عباس. وجوز بعضهم أن تكون: لا، محذوفة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p189/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p189/r8.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p189/r8.claim: The author favors the first view: the verse initially divided believers between excused sick/travelers owing make-up and able residents who could fast or pay fidya, a choice later abrogated.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p189/r8.anchor: والظاهر من هذه الأقوال القول الأول، وذلك أن الله تعالى لما ذكر فرض الصيام

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p192#2/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p192#2/r4.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p192#2/r4.claim: On that parsing, فمن شهد منكم الشهر is the predicate; the author rejects treating its فاء as extra or comparing it with the relative clause after unrestricted الموت, since this شهر is definite and the clause has a verbal antecedent.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p192#2/r4.anchor: وهذا الذي قالوه ليس بشيء، لأن الذي، صفة لعلم، أو لمضاف لعلم

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p192#2/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p192#2/r5.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p192#2/r5.claim: If فمن شهد is the predicate, repeating the subject's wording instead of a pronoun links it back and magnifies the month, as in Arabic poetry.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p192#2/r5.anchor: فأقام لفظ المبتدأ مقام الضمير، وحصل به الربط

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r1.claim: Repeating الموت in the cited line instead of using a pronoun illustrates rhetorical magnification and emphasis through repetition.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r1.anchor: لا أرى الموت يسبق الموت شيء وذلك لتفخيمه وتعظيمه

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r2.speaker: الأخفش
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r2.claim: If the days already mean Ramadan, al-Akhfash parses nominative شهر as the predicate of an omitted subject: 'the prescribed fast is Ramadan'; al-Farra gives a similar estimate.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r2.anchor: أن يكون خبر مبتدأ محذوف تقديره هو: شهر رمضان

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r3.speaker: الكسائي
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r3.claim: Al-Kisa'i parses شهر رمضان as an appositive to الصيام; the author objects to the distant separation and says it reverses the usual content relation of apposition of inclusion.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r3.anchor: قاله الكسائي، وفيه بعد لوجهين: أحدهما

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r4.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r4.claim: Apposition of inclusion is normally a verbal noun related to a month, as in the verse about fighting in the sacred month and an al-Aʿsha poem; the proposed Ramadan apposition would be reversed.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r4.anchor: لأن بدل الاشتمال في الغالب يكون بالمصادر كقوله تعالى: يسئلونك عن الشهر الحرام قتال فيه

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r5.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r5.claim: The apposition could be rescued by supplying صيام before شهر, making both expressions name the same referent, but that requires deletion plus a long intervening distance and is remote.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r5.anchor: تقديره: صيام شهر رمضان، فحذف المضاف، وأقيم المضاف إليه مقامه

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r6.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r6.claim: A possible remote apposition is to أيام معدودات on Abd Allah's nominative reading أيام معدودات, reported by Ibn Khalawayh.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r6.anchor: ويجوز على بعد أن يكون بدلا من أيام معدودات، على قراءة عبد الله

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r7.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r7.claim: For the accusative reading شهر, proposed parses include an implied command صوموا, apposition to أياما, an exhortation الزموا, or attachment to وأن تصوموا; the author rejects the last because a complement of أن cannot be separated from it.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p193/r7.anchor: وانتصاب شهر رمضان على قراءة من قرأ ذلك على إضمار فعل تقديره: صوموا شهر رمضان

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r1.speaker: واثلة بن الأسقع
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r1.claim: Wathila reports from the Prophet that Abraham’s scrolls began on Ramadan’s first night, the Torah on day six, the Gospel on day thirteen, and the Qur’an on day twenty-four.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r1.anchor: وروى واثلة بن الأسقع عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه قال: «أنزلت صحف إبراهيم في أول ليلة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r2.speaker: أبو ذر
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r2.claim: A report from Abu Dharr dates Abraham’s scrolls to Ramadan day three and Jesus’s Gospel to day eighteen.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r2.anchor: وفي رواية أبي ذر: «نزلت صحف إبراهيم في ثلاث مضين من رمضان، وإنجيل عيسى

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r3.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r3.claim: He reconciles the dates by taking Wathila’s report to describe the beginning of revelation and Abu Dharr’s to describe its completion.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r3.anchor: والجمع بين الروايتين بأن رواية واثلة أخبر فيها عن ابتداء نزول الصحف والإنجيل

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r4.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r4.claim: He prefers explaining Ibn Kathir’s reading of al-Qurʾān as transferring the hamza vowel to the rāʾ and dropping the hamza throughout the Qurʾān.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r4.anchor: وقرأ ابن كثير القران بنقل حركة الهمزة إلى الراء، وحذف الهمزة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r5.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r5.claim: An alternative derivation treats the unhamzated nūn in qurʾān as original, from qarana, meaning to join one thing to another.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r5.anchor: وقد تقدم قول من قال: إن النون فيه مع عدم الهمز أصلية من قرنت الشيء في الشيء

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r6.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r6.claim: Hudan is an accusative circumstantial verbal noun functioning as hādiyan; it describes the Qurʾān, with li-l-nās attached to it and anzala as its governor.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r6.anchor: هدى للناس وبينات انتصاب: هدى، على الحال وهو مصدر وضع موضع اسم الفاعل

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r7.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r7.claim: Bayyināt is another necessary circumstantial description, coordinated with hudan; it specifies the manifest kind of guidance among the Qurʾān’s ambiguous and clear teachings.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r7.anchor: وعطف قوله: وبينات، على: هدى، فهو حال أيضا، وهي لازمة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r8.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r8.claim: The phrase from guidance and criterion describes both guidance and clear signs as part of God’s wider guidance and criterion, which include divine scriptures.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r8.anchor: من الهدى والفرقان هذا في موضع الصفة لقوله: هدى وبينات

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r9.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r9.claim: Al-furqān conveys that clear signs distinguish truth from falsehood, and its sound also echoes the preceding verse-endings, making it apt in meaning and cadence.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p195#2/r9.anchor: ولأن في لفظ: الفرقان، مؤاخاة للفاصلة قبله

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p196/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p196/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p196/r1.claim: He rejects the claim that guidance and criterion here mean the Qurʾān itself, since that would make the Qurʾān part of itself.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p196/r1.anchor: ولا يظهر هنا ما قاله بعض الناس من أن الهدى والفرقان أريد به القرآن

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p196/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p196/r2.speaker: المنتخب
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p196/r2.claim: Al-Muntakhab allows the first guidance to mean principles of religion and the second to mean its branches.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p196/r2.anchor: وفي (المنتخب) أنه يحتمل أن يحمل: هدى الأول على أصول الدين، والثاني على فروعه

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p196/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p196/r3.speaker: ابن عطية
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p196/r3.claim: Ibn ʿAṭiyya takes the definite article in al-hudā as anaphoric, pointing back to the first, indefinite hudan.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p196/r3.anchor: وقال ابن عطية: اللام في الهدى للعهد، والمراد الأول.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p196/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p196/r4.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p196/r4.claim: He argues Ibn ʿAṭiyya’s anaphoric reading fails under the syntax: attaching min al-hudā to hudan or bayyināt would make the description part of, or self-specifying for, its referent.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p196/r4.anchor: لا جائز أن يكون صفة لهدى، لأنه من حيث هو وصف لزم أن يكون بعضا

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p196/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p196/r5.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p196/r5.claim: He also rejects attaching min al-hudā to bayyināt, since bayyināt is coordinated as a circumstantial description and would then restrict the Qurʾān through hudan and itself.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p196/r5.anchor: ولا جائز أن يكون صفة لبينات فقط، لأن وبينات معطوف على هدى

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p196/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p196/r6.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p196/r6.claim: He therefore reads hudan and furqān as general categories of divine guidance and criterion, of which this Qurʾān is one part.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p196/r6.anchor: فلذلك اخترنا أن يكون الهدى والفرقان عامين

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r1.claim: Al-shahr refers anaphorically to Ramadan; it could have been replaced by a pronoun, but is stated explicitly for honor and emphasis.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r1.anchor: الألف واللام في الشهر للعهد، ويعني به شهر رمضان، ولذلك ينوب عنه الضمير

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r2.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r2.claim: Witnessing the month means being present in it; al-shahr is an adverbial of time, and a legally responsible resident must fast because the imperative requires obligation.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r2.anchor: ومعنى شهود الشهر الحضور فيه. فانتصاب الشهر على الظرف، والمعنى

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r3.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r3.claim: Grammarians also parse al-shahr as an object with an omitted complement, meaning the town or region witnessed.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r3.anchor: وقالوا على انتصاب الشهر: أنه مفعول به، وهو على حذف مضاف

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r4.speaker: علي، ابن عباس، عبيدة المسلماني، النخعي، السدي
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r4.claim: This group says one who entered Ramadan while resident must complete its fast even if later traveling; only someone already traveling at its entry may break the fast.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r4.anchor: وإلى هذا ذهب علي، وابن عباس، وعبيدة المسلماني، والنخعي، والسدي.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r5.speaker: الجمهور
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r5.claim: The majority say whoever witnesses the month’s beginning or end fasts for as long as resident.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r5.anchor: والجمهور على أن من شهد أول الشهر أو آخره فليصم ما دام مقيما

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r6.speaker: الزمخشري
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r6.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī insists al-shahr and its pronoun are adverbial, since both resident and traveler witness the month.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r6.anchor: قال الزمخشري: الشهر منصوب على الظرف، وكذلك الهاء في: فليصمه

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r7.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r7.claim: He answers that an object reading remains possible if the omitted object is dukhūl al-shahr, entry into the month.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r7.anchor: وقد تقدم أن ذلك يكون على حذف مضاف تقديره: فمن شهد منكم دخول الشهر

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r8.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r8.claim: He calls the proposed ellipsis “the crescent of the month” weak: Arabic uses shāhada rather than shahida for seeing the crescent, and that reading would wrongly oblige everyone who saw it.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r8.anchor: وقيل: التقدير هلال الشهر، وهذا ضعيف، لأنك لا تقول: شهدت الهلال

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r9.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r9.claim: He finds Abū al-Baqāʾ’s parsing of minkum both as a circumstantial phrase and as governed directly by shahida contradictory.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r9.anchor: فتناقض، لأن جعلها حالا يوجب أن يكون العامل محذوفا

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r10.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r10.claim: Man in man shahida may be either conditional or relative, as in earlier parallels.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p197/r10.anchor: ومن، من قوله فمن شهد، الظاهر أنها شرطية، ويجوز أن تكون موصولة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p201/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p201/r1.speaker: الكسائي والفراء
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p201/r1.claim: Al-Kisāʾī and al-Farrāʾ say Arabic sometimes uses the purpose lām where an is expected after arāda and amara.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p201/r1.anchor: بل ذلك مذهب الكسائي والفراء، زعما أن العرب تجعل لام كي في موضع أن

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p201/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p201/r2.speaker: سيبويه وأصحابه
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p201/r2.claim: Sībawayh and his associates keep the lām in its ordinary sense and posit an elided an after it, with the preceding verb construed as a verbal noun.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p201/r2.anchor: وذهب سيبويه وأصحابه إلى أن اللام هنا باقية على حالها وأن مضمرة بعدها

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p201/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p201/r3.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p201/r3.claim: Some grammarians instead call the lām extra; he refers readers to his earlier extended treatment of the issue.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p201/r3.anchor: وذهب بعض الناس إلى زيادة اللام

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p201/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p201/r4.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p201/r4.claim: He says Ibn ʿAṭiyya mislabels the analysis as Basran: treating the lām as the direct-object lām conflicts with also making it part of an elided-an construction.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p201/r4.anchor: وتناقض قول ابن عطية أيضا لأنه قال: هي اللام الداخلة على المفعول

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p201/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p201/r5.speaker: ابن عطية
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p201/r5.claim: Ibn ʿAṭiyya proposes that the lām is a command lām and the wāw coordinates one independent clause with another.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p201/r5.anchor: ويحتمل أن تكون هذه اللام لام الأمر والواو عاطفة جملة كلام على جملة كلام

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r1.claim: He rejects the command-lām analysis: the second-person imperative with an overt address prefix and lām is a rare poor dialect, and no reader is reported to have made this lām vowelless.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r1.anchor: اللغة الأخرى هي الجيدة الفصيحة، وهو، أن يكون الفعل عاريا من حرف المضارعة ومن اللام

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r2.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r2.claim: Since command lām would be read with the other command-lām forms, the reported reading supports a prepositional, not imperative, lām; the wāw then coordinates phrases rather than clauses.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r2.anchor: فلو كانت لام الأمر لكانت كسائر أخواتها من القراءة بالوجهين فيها

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r3.speaker: الزمخشري
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r3.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī makes the lām causal and coordinates it with an omitted cause: God wills ease so that people complete the count.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r3.anchor: أحدها: أن تكون الواو عاطفة على علة محذوفة، التقدير: لتعملوا ما تعملون ولتكملوا العدة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r4.speaker: الفراء
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r4.claim: Al-Farrāʾ supplies an omitted verb after the wāw: the act was done so that the count would be completed.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r4.anchor: أن يكون بعد الواو فعل محذوف هو المعلل، التقدير: وفعل هذا لتكملوا العدة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r5.speaker: الزجاج
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r5.claim: Al-Zajjāj makes it coordinated with an omitted cause whose result is also omitted: God did this to ease matters and to complete the count.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r5.anchor: أن يكون معطوفا على علة محذوفة وقد حذف معلولها، التقدير: فعل الله ذلك ليسهل عليكم ولتكملوا

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r6.speaker: ابن عطية
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r6.claim: Ibn ʿAṭiyya reports a Kūfan view that places the implied causal act after its purpose: the concession was granted so you could complete the count.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r6.anchor: أن يكون الفعل المعلل مقدرا بعد التعليل، تقديره: ولأن تكملوا العدة رخص لكم هذه الرخصة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r7.speaker: قائلون
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r7.claim: Another proposal treats the wāw as extra, yielding “God wills ease in order to complete the count”; Abū Ḥayyān calls it weak.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r7.anchor: الخامس: أن الواو زائدة، التقدير: يريد الله بكم اليسر لتكملوا العدة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r8.speaker: الزمخشري
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r8.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī assigns the implied act “He legislated this” to the whole passage: completing the count, magnifying God, and giving thanks each have a distinct purpose.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r8.anchor: شرع ذلك، يعني جملة ما ذكر من أمر الشاهد بصوم الشهر

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r9.speaker: الزمخشري
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r9.claim: He calls this distribution of purposes a subtle rhetorical “folding” construction that only expert critics readily unpack.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202/r9.anchor: وهذا نوع من اللف لطيف المسلك لا يكاد يهتدي إلى تبيينه

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r1.claim: The definite article in al-ʿidda most likely refers to make-up days missed in illness or travel, so one fasts an equal number of days later.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r1.anchor: والألف واللام في قوله: ولتكملوا العدة الظاهر أنها للعهد

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r2.speaker: قيل
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r2.claim: An alternative takes the count to mean a complete lunar Ramadan, whether it has twenty-nine or thirty days.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r2.anchor: وقيل: عدة الهلال سواء كانت تسعة وعشرين يوما أم كان ثلاثين

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r3.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r3.claim: The lām in “that you magnify God” is coordinated with the lām in completing the count and has the same grammatical analysis.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r3.anchor: ولتكبروا الله على ما هداكم معطوف على: ولتكملوا العدة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r4.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r4.claim: Takbīr here means magnifying and praising God in any words of praise, not necessarily the formula Allahu akbar.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r4.anchor: ومعنى التكبير هنا تعظيم الله والثناء عليه، فلا يختص ذلك بلفظ التكبير

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r5.speaker: قيل
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r5.claim: Others take the phrase as the specific takbīr at sighting the Shawwāl crescent; Ibn ʿAbbās says Muslims must magnify God when they see it.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r5.anchor: وروي عن ابن عباس أنه قال: حق على المسلمين إذا رأوا هلال شوال أن يكبروا

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r6.speaker: سفيان
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r6.claim: Sufyān identifies the takbīr with the Eid al-Fiṭr day.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r6.anchor: وقال سفيان: هو التكبير يوم الفطر.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r7.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says takbīr begins at the crescent and lasts until the sermon ends, pausing when the imam goes out and resuming with him.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r7.anchor: فعن ابن عباس: يكبر من رؤية الهلال إلى انقضاء الخطبة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r8.speaker: الشافعي
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r8.claim: Al-Shāfiʿī’s reported period runs from sighting the crescent until the imam goes out to prayer.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r8.anchor: وقيل: وهو قول الشافعي: من رؤية الهلال إلى خروج الإمام إلى الصلاة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r9.speaker: زيد بن أسلم ومالك
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r9.claim: Zayd b. Aslam and Mālik begin takbīr when a person leaves home and continue until the imam goes out.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r9.anchor: وقال زيد بن أسلم، ومالك: من حين يخرج من منزله إلى أن يخرج الإمام

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r10.speaker: ابن القاسم وعلي بن زياد
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r10.claim: They distinguish departure before versus after sunrise: an early departure waits until sunrise, while a later one includes takbīr en route and while waiting for the imam.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r10.anchor: وروى ابن القاسم، وعلي بن زياد: إن خرج قبل طلوع الشمس فلا يكبر

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r11.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r11.speaker: أحمد
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r11.claim: Reports from Aḥmad differ on when takbīr stops at the prayer ground; Abū Yaʿlā reads one report as ending when the imam appears, while Ḥanbal says it ends after the sermon.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r11.anchor: واختلف عن أحمد، فنقل الأثر عنه أنه إذا جاء إلى المصلى يقطع

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r12.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r12.speaker: مالك، الشافعي، أحمد، أبو يوسف، محمد
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r12.claim: Mālik, al-Shāfiʿī, Aḥmad, Abū Yūsuf, and Muḥammad treat Eid al-Aḍḥā and Eid al-Fiṭr alike for takbīr; Abū Ḥanīfa restricts it to Aḍḥā.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r12.anchor: فقال مالك، والشافعي، وأحمد، وأبو يوسف، ومحمد: الفطر والأضحى سواء

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r13.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r13.speaker: الجمهور
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r13.claim: The majority say the formula is Allahu akbar three times, a form transmitted from Jābir; other formulas add tahlīl, tasbīḥ, or praise.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r13.anchor: وكيفيته عند الجمهور: الله أكبر الله أكبر الله أكبر، ثلاثا، وهو مروي عن جابر

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r14.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r14.speaker: ابن المبارك
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r14.claim: Ibn al-Mubārak’s formula adds the testimony of God’s oneness, praise, and gratitude for guidance.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r14.anchor: وكان ابن المبارك يقول: الله أكبر الله أكبر لا إله إلا الله

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r15.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r15.speaker: مالك
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r15.claim: Ibn al-Mundhir reports that Mālik did not set a fixed limit for the takbīr.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r15.anchor: وقال ابن المنذر: كان مالك لا يجد فيه حدا

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r16.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r16.speaker: ابن العربي
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r16.claim: Ibn al-ʿArabī says his school chose unrestricted takbīr, which he considers the apparent sense of the text; Aḥmad says all forms are acceptable.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p202#2/r16.anchor: وقال ابن العربي: اختار علماؤنا التكبير المطلق وهو ظاهر الكتاب

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r1.speaker: المنتخب
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r1.claim: Al-Muntakhab prefers taking completion of the count as Ramadan fasting and magnification as takbīr at its end for guidance to obedience, not generic glorification.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r1.anchor: ورجح في (المنتخب) أن إكمال العدة هو في صوم رمضان

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r2.speaker: المنتخب
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r2.claim: It argues that general glorification is already required at all times and in every act of worship, so it would not be specially mentioned here.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r2.anchor: لأن تكبير الله بمعنى تعظيمه هو واجب في جميع الأوقات

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r3.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r3.claim: The preposition ʿalā attached to takabbirū carries a causal implication, as in thanking someone for a favor.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r3.anchor: و: على، تتعلق: بتكبروا، وفيها إشعار بالعلية

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r4.speaker: الزمخشري
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r4.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī explains the elevated preposition as takbīr carrying an implied sense of praise: magnify God while praising Him for guiding you.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r4.anchor: قال الزمخشري: وإنما عدى فعل التكبر بحرف الاستعلاء لكونه مضمنًا معنى الحمد

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r5.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r5.claim: He says al-Zamakhsharī’s wording explains the meaning, not the syntax; syntactically the sense is to praise God through takbīr for His guidance.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r5.anchor: هو تفسير معنى لا تفسير إعراب

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r6.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r6.claim: The apparent reading makes mā a verbal noun, meaning “for your being guided”; reading it as “that which” requires two unlikely omissions.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r6.anchor: والظاهر في: ما، أنها مصدرية أي: على هدايتكم

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r7.speaker: قيل
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r7.claim: If mā is relative, the phrase means guidance to the Islamic law, or guidance away from the Christians’ alteration of fasting.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r7.anchor: وقيل: المعنى، هدايتكم لما ضل فيه النصارى من تبديل صيامهم

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r8.speaker: ابن عطية
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r8.claim: Ibn ʿAṭiyya takes “perhaps you will give thanks” as human-oriented hope and thanks for guidance.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r8.anchor: هو ترج في حق البشر على نعمة الله في الهداية، قاله ابن عطية

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r9.speaker: قيل
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r9.claim: Another explanation makes the thanks due for the reward God grants for acts of obedience.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p203/r9.anchor: وقيل: المعنى تشكرون على ما أنعم به من ثواب طاعاتكم.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p228/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p228/r2.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p228/r2.claim: Legal obligations characteristically begin with what is easier and proceed to the required limit, where the ruling settles.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p228/r2.anchor: وهكذا جرت العادة في التكاليف الشرعية يبتدأ فيها أولا بالأخف

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p228/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p228/r3.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p228/r3.claim: The month’s virtue is tied to revelation of the Qur’an; residents must fast it, while the sick and traveler make up what they missed after recovery or settling, in keeping with divine intent to ease the burden.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p228/r3.anchor: ونبه على فضيلة هذا الشهر المفروض بأنه الشهر الذي أنزل فيه الوحي

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p228/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p228/r4.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p228/r4.claim: The prescribed month, exemption for illness and travel, and divine desire for ease serve completion of the count, magnification of God, and gratitude, each law being paired with its fitting purpose.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p228/r4.anchor: ثم ذكر أن مشروعية صوم الشهر، وإباحة الفطر للمريض والمسافر

NAHHAS:v1p288/r1.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v1p288/r1.speaker: الحسن
NAHHAS:v1p288/r1.claim: Hasan, Qatada, the two Asims, and al-Araj read ولتكملوا; al-Kisa'i prefers it by analogy with completing the religion.
NAHHAS:v1p288/r1.anchor: وقرأ الحسن وقتادة والعاصمان والأعرج ( ولتكملوا العدة )

DURR-FULL:v1p427/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v1p427/r3.speaker: author
DURR-FULL:v1p427/r3.claim: Fasting began with the Prophet fasting three days monthly and ʿĀshūrāʾ; fasting was then obligatory with a choice of feeding, before Ramadan became obligatory for healthy residents, with illness and travel exemptions and feeding retained for the very old.
DURR-FULL:v1p427/r3.anchor: فكان من شاء صام ومن شاء أطعم مسكينا فاجزأ ذلك عنه ثم إن الله أنزل الآية الأخرى

DURR-FULL:v1p430/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v1p430/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v1p430/r5.claim: At first a person could fast or feed a poor person instead; the later command to fast abrogated that choice except for the very old, who may feed instead.
DURR-FULL:v1p430/r5.anchor: عن ابن عباس قال: نزلت هذه الآية {وعلى الذين يطيقونه فدية} فكان من شاء صام

DURR-FULL:v1p430/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v1p430/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v1p430/r6.claim: The fidya option was a choice, but fasting was better; the later command made fasting obligatory for those present in the month.
DURR-FULL:v1p430/r6.anchor: عن ابن عباس {وعلى الذين يطيقونه فدية} ومن شاء منهم أن يفتدي بطعام مسكين افتدى

DURR-FULL:v1p430/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v1p430/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v1p430/r7.claim: The earlier fidya concession covered elderly people able to fast and was later abrogated for them; those unable to fast, pregnant women, and nursing mothers fearing harm may feed a poor person per day without making up the fast.
DURR-FULL:v1p430/r7.anchor: عن ابن عباس في الآية قال: كانت مرخصة الشيخ الكبير والعجوز وهما يطيقان الصوم

THALABI:v2p67/r4.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p67/r4.speaker: العامة
THALABI:v2p67/r4.claim: The common reading puts شهر رمضان in the nominative, understood as a new clause such as أتاكم شهر رمضان.
THALABI:v2p67/r4.anchor: شهر رمضان قرأه العامة رفع على معنى أتاكم شهر رمضان

THALABI:v2p67/r5.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p67/r5.speaker: الفراء والأخفش والكسائي
THALABI:v2p67/r5.claim: They offer different omitted predicates for the nominative reading: that is Ramadan, it is Ramadan, or fasting Ramadan was prescribed.
THALABI:v2p67/r5.anchor: الأخفش: هو شهر رمضان. الكسائي: كتب عليكم شهر رمضان

THALABI:v2p67/r6.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p67/r6.speaker: الحسن ومجاهد وشهر بن حوشب
THALABI:v2p67/r6.claim: They read شهر رمضان in the accusative, interpreted as an instruction to fast the month; other grammarians analyze it as temporal adverbial or exhortative.
THALABI:v2p67/r6.anchor: شهر رمضان نصبا على هو يعني صوموا شهر رمضان

THALABI:v2p67/r7.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p67/r7.speaker: أبو عمرو
THALABI:v2p67/r7.claim: Abu Amr assimilates the two adjacent r sounds in شهر رمضان for ease of articulation.
THALABI:v2p67/r7.anchor: قرأ أبو عمرو: مدغما شهر رمضان على مذهب

THALABI:v2p67/r8.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p67/r8.speaker: author
THALABI:v2p67/r8.claim: The word شهر is tied to notoriety; al-Farra also derives it from whiteness, with examples of unsheathing a sword and the moon appearing.
THALABI:v2p67/r8.anchor: هو مأخوذ من الشهرة وهي البياض ومنه يقال

THALABI:v2p67/r9.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p67/r9.speaker: بعضهم
THALABI:v2p67/r9.claim: One opinion treats Ramadan as a name of God, supporting the wording month of Ramadan; a report from Ja'far al-Sadiq's forebears attributes that phrase to the Prophet.
THALABI:v2p67/r9.anchor: رمضان اسم من أسماء الله فيقال شهر رمضان

THALABI:v2p67/r10.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p67/r10.speaker: أنس عن هشيم عن أبان
THALABI:v2p67/r10.claim: A report attributed to the Prophet says not to say Ramadan alone but to call it the month of Ramadan as the Qur'an does.
THALABI:v2p67/r10.anchor: لا تقولوا رمضان، انسبوه كما نسبه الله تعالى في القرآن

THALABI:v2p67/r11.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p67/r11.speaker: أبو عمرو
THALABI:v2p67/r11.claim: Abu Amr says Ramadan was named because good deeds are scorched in it.
THALABI:v2p67/r11.anchor: إنما سمي رمضان لأنه رمضت فيه الفعال من الخير

THALABI:v2p67/r12.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p67/r12.speaker: غيره
THALABI:v2p67/r12.claim: Other explanations connect Ramadan with hot stones, the burning away of sins, or hearts being heated by admonition and reflection on the afterlife.
THALABI:v2p67/r12.anchor: لأن الحجارة كانت ترمض فيه من الحرارة والرمضاء الحجارة المحماة

THALABI:v2p68/r1.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p68/r1.speaker: الخليل
THALABI:v2p68/r1.claim: Al-Khalil derives Ramadan from autumn rain, saying it washes bodily sins and purifies hearts.
THALABI:v2p68/r1.anchor: مأخوذة من الرمض وهو مطر يأتي في الخريف فسمي هذا الشهر رمضان

THALABI:v2p68/r2.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p68/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
THALABI:v2p68/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas explains that the Qur'an descended whole from the Preserved Tablet on Ramadan's Night of Decree to the lower heaven, then Gabriel brought it to Muhammad in stages over twenty years.
THALABI:v2p68/r2.anchor: أنزل القرآن جملة واحدة من اللوح المحفوظ في ليلة القدر من شهر رمضان

THALABI:v2p68/r3.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p68/r3.speaker: الشعبي
THALABI:v2p68/r3.claim: Al-Sha'bi says Gabriel reviewed the year's revelations with Muhammad in Ramadan, confirming, retaining, or causing him to forget what God willed.

THALABI:v2p68/r4.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p68/r4.speaker: أبو ذر الغفاري
THALABI:v2p68/r4.claim: A report lists revelation dates for Abraham's scrolls, the Torah, Gospel, Psalms, and Qur'an as successive nights in Ramadan.
THALABI:v2p68/r4.anchor: أنزلت صحف إبراهيم في ثلاثة ليال مضين من رمضان

THALABI:v2p68/r5.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p68/r5.speaker: سلمان
THALABI:v2p68/r5.claim: Salman's report of the Prophet's end-of-Sha'ban sermon calls Ramadan a blessed month containing a night better than a thousand months, with fasting obligatory and night prayer voluntary.
THALABI:v2p68/r5.anchor: سلمان قال: خطبنا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في آخر يوم من شعبان

THALABI:v2p68/r6.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p68/r6.speaker: سلمان
THALABI:v2p68/r6.claim: The sermon promises extraordinary reward for good deeds and obligations, calls Ramadan a month of patience and generosity, and says believers' provision increases.
THALABI:v2p68/r6.anchor: من تقرب فيه بخصلة من خصال الخير كان كمن أدى فريضة

THALABI:v2p68/r7.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p68/r7.speaker: سلمان
THALABI:v2p68/r7.claim: The sermon says the month's beginning brings mercy, its middle forgiveness, and its end release from the Fire; feeding a fasting person earns forgiveness and an equal reward.
THALABI:v2p68/r7.anchor: شهر أوله رحمة وأوسطه مغفرة وآخره عتق من النار

THALABI:v2p68/r8.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p68/r8.speaker: سلمان
THALABI:v2p68/r8.claim: The Prophet says even a sip of milk, a date, or water earns the feeding reward; a full meal earns a drink from his basin without thirst until Paradise.
THALABI:v2p68/r8.anchor: من فطر صائما على مذقة لبن أو تمر أو شربة ماء

THALABI:v2p68/r9.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p68/r9.speaker: سلمان
THALABI:v2p68/r9.claim: The sermon urges easing a slave's work and seeking four practices: testimony and repentance to please God, and asking for Paradise and refuge from Hell.
THALABI:v2p68/r9.anchor: فيه من أربع خصال: خصلتان ترضون بها ربكم

THALABI:v2p69/r1.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p69/r1.speaker: أبو سعيد الخدري
THALABI:v2p69/r1.claim: Abu Sa'id reports that heaven and Paradise gates open on Ramadan's first night; each prayer earns a large reward, daily fasting brings forgiveness and a palace, and angels seek forgiveness for the faster.
THALABI:v2p69/r1.anchor: إن أبواب السماء وأبواب الجنة لتفتح لأول ليلة من شهر رمضان

THALABI:v2p69/r2.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p69/r2.speaker: قتادة عن أنس
THALABI:v2p69/r2.claim: A report says the first night renews Paradise and closes Hell to Muhammad's community, chains rebellious devils, and frees servants from the Fire daily.
THALABI:v2p69/r2.anchor: إذا كان أول ليلة من شهر رمضان نادى الجليل جلت عظمته

THALABI:v2p69/r3.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p69/r3.speaker: قتادة عن أنس
THALABI:v2p69/r3.claim: In the same report, a heavenly caller invites repentance, supplication, justice, forgiveness, and requests; God urges endurance throughout the month, and angels descend on Laylat al-Qadr.
THALABI:v2p69/r3.anchor: هل تائب يتاب عليه؟ هل من داع يستجاب له؟

THALABI:v2p70/r1.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p70/r1.speaker: أنس عن إبراهيم بن هدية
THALABI:v2p70/r1.claim: Anas reports that if God let heaven and earth speak about someone who fasted Ramadan, they would say: Paradise.
THALABI:v2p70/r1.anchor: لو أذن الله للسماوات والأرض أن يتكلما بشرا بمن صام رمضان

THALABI:v2p70/r2.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p70/r2.speaker: عبد الله بن أبي أوفى
THALABI:v2p70/r2.claim: The Prophet is reported to say that a faster's sleep is worship, silence is glorification, supplication is answered, and deeds are multiplied.
THALABI:v2p70/r2.anchor: نوم الصائم عبادة وصمته تسبيح ودعاؤه مستجاب

THALABI:v2p70/r3.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p70/r3.speaker: العامة
THALABI:v2p70/r3.claim: The common reading of فليصمه has a jussive lam; Hasan and al-Araj read it with kasra, which is proper when the command lam is isolated, while connection permits either vowel.
THALABI:v2p70/r3.anchor: قرأه العامة بجزم اللام، وقرأ الحسن والأعرج: بكسر اللام

THALABI:v2p70/r4.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p70/r4.speaker: أبو حنيفة وأصحابه
THALABI:v2p70/r4.claim: They interpret witnessing the month as being sane, adult, resident, healthy, and legally responsible, and therefore required to fast.
THALABI:v2p70/r4.anchor: معناها فمن شهده عاقلا بالغا مقيما صحيحا مكلفا فليصمه

THALABI:v2p70/r5.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p70/r5.speaker: النخعي والسدي
THALABI:v2p70/r5.claim: They say anyone who enters Ramadan while resident must complete the whole month's fast, even if he later travels.
THALABI:v2p70/r5.anchor: إذا دخل عليه شهر رمضان وهو مقيم في داره فليصم الشهر كله

THALABI:v2p70/r6.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p70/r6.speaker: علي
THALABI:v2p70/r6.claim: Ali says someone who meets Ramadan at home and then travels still has to fast.
THALABI:v2p70/r6.anchor: إذا أدركه رمضان وهو مقيم ثم سافر فعليه الصوم

THALABI:v2p70/r7.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p70/r7.speaker: محمد بن سيرين عن عبيدة السلماني
THALABI:v2p70/r7.claim: Ubayda says that one who witnessed the month's beginning should fast its end; the view recommends not leaving home after Ramadan begins.

THALABI:v2p70/r8.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p70/r8.speaker: ابن عباس وعامة أهل التأويل
THALABI:v2p70/r8.claim: The author says the sounder view is to fast while present and take the concession to break the fast when traveling; he cites the Prophet drinking during the Ramadan conquest journey.
THALABI:v2p70/r8.anchor: وهو أصح الأقاويل يدل عليه ما روى الزهري عن عبيد الله

THALABI:v2p73/r10.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p73/r10.speaker: أكثر العلماء
THALABI:v2p73/r10.claim: Most scholars understand magnifying God to mean reciting takbir on Eid eve.

THALABI:v2p73/r11.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p73/r11.speaker: ابن عباس وزيد بن أسلم
THALABI:v2p73/r11.claim: They say Muslims should say takbir from sighting Shawwal's crescent until the imam arrives, then stop unless following his takbir; the preferred wording repeats it three times.
THALABI:v2p73/r11.anchor: إذا رأى هلال شوال أن يكبروا إلى أن يخرج الإمام

THALABI:v2p73/r12.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v2p73/r12.speaker: author
THALABI:v2p73/r12.claim: God is to be magnified for guidance, enabling the faith, and granting Ramadan, which is a distinction from other religious communities.
THALABI:v2p73/r12.anchor: على ما هداكم لدينه ووفقكم ورزقكم شهر رمضان

SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]هذانرجلانوعبداللهمنطل.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]هذانرجلانوعبداللهمنطل.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]هذانرجلانوعبداللهمنطل.claim: The accusative منطلقين is a circumstantial predicate: it cannot modify only عبدالله or both the two men and عبدالله as an adjective.
SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]هذانرجلانوعبداللهمنطل.anchor: لأنه لا سبيل إلى أن يكون صفة لعبد الله ولا أن

SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]هذانرجلانوعبداللهمنطل.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]هذانرجلانوعبداللهمنطل.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]هذانرجلانوعبداللهمنطل.claim: The nominative dual منطلقان is also possible when the predicate is understood to describe only the two men, excluding عبدالله.
SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]هذانرجلانوعبداللهمنطل.anchor: وإن شئت قلت هذان رجلان وعبد الله منطلقان

SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]هذانرجلانوعبداللهمنطل.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]هذانرجلانوعبداللهمنطل.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]هذانرجلانوعبداللهمنطل.claim: With هؤلاء ناس and عبدالله, accusative منطلقين makes a shared circumstantial phrase; nominative منطلقون instead agrees with ناس alone.
SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]هذانرجلانوعبداللهمنطل.anchor: وتقول هؤلاء ناس وعبد الله منطلقين إذا خلطتهم

SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]هذانرجلانوعبداللهمنطل.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]هذانرجلانوعبداللهمنطل.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]هذانرجلانوعبداللهمنطل.claim: The sheep-and-lamb example means one dirham for each sheep and its lamb; in this construction the lamb is not included in كل as a definite item.
SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]هذانرجلانوعبداللهمنطل.anchor: وإنما يريد كل شاة وسخلة لها بدرهم

SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]هذانرجلانوعبداللهمنطل.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]هذانرجلانوعبداللهمنطل.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]هذانرجلانوعبداللهمنطل.claim: Sībawayh prefers راتعين with كل شاة وسخلتها and وهذه ناقة وفصيلها: it is more common and analogical; some Arabs use the alternative nominative.
SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]هذانرجلانوعبداللهمنطل.anchor: والوجه كل شاة وسخلتها بدرهم وهذه ناقة وفصيلها

SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r1.claim: The well-known reading has شهر رمضان in the nominative.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r1.anchor: قوله تعالى: { شهر رمضان }: فيه قراءتان، المشهورة الرفع

SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r2.claim: On one parse, شهر رمضان is a مبتدأ with الذي أنزل فيه القرآن as predicate; the clause highlights the month's merit as the month whose fast was prescribed.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r2.anchor: أحدها: أنه مبتدأ، وفي خبره حينئذ قولان، الأول: أنه قوله { الذي أنزل فيه القرآن }

SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r3.speaker: الأخفش
SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r3.claim: Al-Akhfash makes فمن شهد... the predicate of شهر رمضان and treats its فاء as extra; the author rejects analogy with الجمعة 8 because الموت الذي تفرون منه suggests generality unlike Ramadan.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r3.anchor: والقول الثاني: أنه قوله: { فمن شهد منكم الشهر فليصمه } وتكون الفاء زائدة وذلك على رأي الأخفش

SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r4.speaker: الفراء
SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r4.claim: If the numbered days are Ramadan, شهر رمضان can predicate an omitted مبتدأ, estimated by al-Farra as ذلكم شهر رمضان; when they are not Ramadan it can itself be مبتدأ.

SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r5.speaker: الأخفش
SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r5.claim: For the parse where the numbered days are Ramadan, al-Akhfash estimates المكتوب شهر as the omitted مبتدأ's predicate.

SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r6.speaker: الكسائي
SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r6.claim: Al-Kisa'i makes شهر a بدل from الصيام; the author calls it very remote because of the long separation and because it requires reversed بدل الاشتمال.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r6.anchor: وهذا الوجه وإن كان ذهب إليه الكسائي بعيد جدا لوجهين، أحدهما: كثرة الفصل

SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r7.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r7.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r7.claim: That بدل can be defended by estimating the omitted noun صيام, making the بدل and antecedent one entity.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r7.anchor: ويمكن أن يوجه قوله بأن الكلام على حذف مضاف تقديره: صيام شهر رمضان

SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r8.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r8.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r8.claim: Another remote parse makes شهر بدل from أياما معدودات in Abdullah's nominative reading of أياما.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r8.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون الرفع على البدل من قوله " أياما معدودات " في قراءة من رفع " أياما "

SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r9.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r9.speaker: الأعشى
SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r9.claim: The author illustrates بدل الاشتمال with 2:217 and al-A'sha's line; in the poem a ظرف replaces a verbal noun.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185/r9.anchor:
وقول الأعشى:
844 لقد كان في حول ثواء ثويته

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r1.claim: The less common reading puts شهر رمضان in the accusative.

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r2.claim: The best accusative parse supplies an imperative: صوموا شهر رمضان.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r2.anchor: أجودها، النصب بإضمار فعل أي: صوموا شهر رمضان

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r3.speaker: الأخفش والرماني
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r3.claim: Al-Akhfash and al-Rummani parse شهر as بدل from أياما معدودات, supporting the view that the numbered days are Ramadan, though the author notes the separation.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r3.anchor: الثاني - وذكره الأخفش والرماني -: أن يكون بدلا من قوله " أياما معدودات "

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r4.speaker: أبو عبيدة والحوفي
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r4.claim: Abu Ubayda and al-Hawfi parse the accusative as نصب على الإغراء.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r4.anchor: نصب على الإغراء ذكره أبو عبيدة والحوفي

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r5.speaker: ابن عطية والزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r5.claim: Ibn Atiyya and al-Zamakhshari link the accusative to وأن تصوموا, but the author rejects splitting the relative clause across unrelated خير; شهر is a direct object, not an adverb.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r5.anchor: وغلطهما الشيخ: " بأنه يلزم منه الفصل بين الموصول وصلته بأجنبي، لأن الخبر وهو " خير " أجنبي من الموصول

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r6.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r6.claim: A fifth parse makes شهر the object of تعملون after deleting an إضافة: تعلمون شرف شهر رمضان.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r6.anchor: أنه منصوب بـ " تعملون " على حذف مضاف، تقديره: تعلمون شرف شهر رمضان

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r7.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r7.speaker: أبو عمر
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r7.claim: Abu Amr assimilates the راء of شهر into the راء of رمضان; the author rejects Ibn Atiyya's objection because reliable transmission prevails over analogy.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r7.anchor: وأدغم أبو عمر راء " شهر " في راء " رمضان " ، ولا يلتفت إلى من استضعفها

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r8.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r8.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r8.claim: The common definition of شهر is a period from the new moon's initial concealment until it disappears; its name reflects people's need to know it.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r8.anchor: أشهرهما: أنه اسم لمدة الزمان التي يكون مبدؤها الهلال خافيا إلى أن يستسر

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r9.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r9.speaker: الزجاج
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r9.claim: Al-Zajjaj says شهر names the moon itself, called so for its visibility; a cited saying compares it to a fingernail clipping.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r9.anchor: والثاني - قاله الزجاج - أنه اسم للهلال نفسه

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r10.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r10.speaker: ذو الرمة
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r10.claim: Dhu al-Rumma's line sees the thin crescent before other people, witnessing شهر as the visible moon.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r10.anchor:
قال ذو الرمة:
846 ...................
يرى الشهر قبل الناس وهو نحيل

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r11.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r11.speaker: الفراء والثعلبي
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r11.claim: The moon's name extended to the period beginning with its rising: رأيت الشهر means its crescent; Farra reports أشهرنا and al-Tha'labi says شهر الهلال means it rose.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r11.anchor: قال الثعلبي: " يقال شهر الهلال إذا طلع "

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r12.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r12.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r12.claim: The regular plural is أشهر for a small number and شهور for many.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#2/r12.anchor: ويجمع في القلة على أشهر/ وفي الكثرة على شهور

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r1.claim: Ramadan is the generic proper name for this specific month.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r1.anchor: ورمضان علم لهذا الشهر المخصوص وهو علم جنس

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r2.claim: One etymology says Ramadan arrived during the intense summer heat الرمضاء, like Rabi and Jumada named for their seasons.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r2.anchor: أنه وافق مجيئه في الرمضاء - وهي شدة الحر - فسمي بذلك، كربيع لموافقته الربيع

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r3.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r3.claim: Other proposed derivations say Ramadan burns sins away and hearts burn from admonition.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r3.anchor: وقيل: لأنه يرمض الذنوب أي: يحرقها بمعنى يمحوها

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r4.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r4.claim: A blade etymology describes thinning a blade between stones; a sharpened blade is called رميض or مرموض.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r4.anchor: وقيل: من رمضت النصل دققته بين حجرين ليرق يقال: نصل رميض ومرموض

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r5.speaker: المفضل
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r5.claim: The month was called ناتق in pre-Islamic times; al-Mufaddal's poem uses that name.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r5.anchor: وكان اسمه في الجاهلية ناتقا. أنشد المفضل

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r6.speaker: الزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r6.claim: Al-Zamakhshari derives رمضان as a verbal noun from رمض إذا احترق; the author says this requires attestation because فعَلان is not usually a verbal noun of an intransitive verb.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r6.anchor: وقال الزمشخري: " الرمضان مصدر رمض إذا احترق من الرمضاء "

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r7.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r7.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r7.claim: Another etymology connects the name to pre-autumn rain that cleans dust from earth, analogously cleansing hearts of sins.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r7.anchor: مطر يأتي قبل الخريف يطهر الأرض من الغبار فكذلك هذا الشهر يطهر القلوب من الذنوب

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r8.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r8.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r8.claim: القرآن was originally the verbal noun of قرأت and later became the name for what lies between the covers.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r8.anchor: ثم صار علما لما بين الدفتين ويدل على كونه مصدرا

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r9.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r9.speaker: حسان
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r9.claim: Hassan's verse about Uthman uses قرآنا as a verbal noun, evidence for القرآن's original مصدر meaning.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r9.anchor:
قول حسان في عثمان رضي الله عنهما:
848 ضحوا بأشمط عنوان السجود به
يقطع الليل تسبيحا وقرآنا

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r10.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r10.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r10.claim: The hamzated word derives from قرأ, 'to gather', because the Quran gathers suras, verses, rulings, and admonitions.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r10.anchor: وهو من قرأ بالهمز أي: جمع، لأنه يجمع السور والآيات والحكم والمواعظ

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r11.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r11.speaker: ابن كثير
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r11.claim: Ibn Kathir reads القرآن without hamza; the author gives two derivations for this form.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r11.anchor: وقرأ ابن كثير من غير همز

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r12.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r12.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r12.claim: The more evident analysis is نقل: like Warsh, Ibn Kathir transfers the hamza vowel to the preceding consonant and deletes it, a special choice due to frequent use and combining two forms.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r12.anchor: أظهرهما: أنه من باب النقل، كما ينقل ورش حركة الهمزة إلى الساكن قبلها ثم يحذفها

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r13.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r13.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r13.claim: The alternative derives it from قرنت, 'joined two things', on pattern فعال because the Quran joins its suras, verses, rulings, and admonitions.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r13.anchor: والثاني: أنه مشتق عنده من قرنت بين الشيئين، فيكون وزنه على هذا: فعالا

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r14.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r14.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r14.claim: Derivation from قريت الماء في الحوض ('collected water in a basin') is wrong because the two roots are distinct.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r14.anchor: وأما قول من قال إنه مشتق من قريت الماء في الحوض أي جمعته فغلط

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r15.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r15.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r15.claim: In أنزل فيه القرآن, القرآن is نائب الفاعل.

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r16.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r16.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r16.claim: أنزل فيه القرآن may mean revelation occurred in Ramadan, some specifying its twenty-fourth day; another view takes فيه as concerning Ramadan's status and merit.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#3/r16.anchor: ومعنى { أنزل فيه القرآن }: أن القرآن نزل فيه فهو ظرف لإنزاله

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#4/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#4/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#4/r1.claim: هدى is an accusative حال from القرآن, governed by أنزل; as a مصدر it may mean ذو هدى, function as هاديا, or intensively be guidance itself.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#4/r1.anchor: في محل نصب على الحال من القرآن، والعامل فيه " أنزل " وهدى ومصدر

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#4/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#4/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#4/r2.claim: للناس either attaches to هدى if it means هاد, or is an omitted phrase adjectivally qualifying the preceding indefinite noun.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#4/r2.anchor: أحدهما: أن يتعلق بـ " هدى " على قولنا بأنه وقع موقع " هاد "

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#4/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#4/r3.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#4/r3.claim: هدى cannot predicate omitted هو because بينات is overtly accusative; بينات is a second necessary حال and a specific kind of general guidance, which includes hidden and manifest matters.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#4/r3.anchor: ولا يجوز أن يكون " هدى " خبر مبتدأ محذوف تقديره: " هو هدى " لأنه عطف عليه منصوب صريح

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#5/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#5/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#5/r1.claim: من الهدى والفرقان qualifies هدى وبينات in the accusative and depends on an omitted phrase: the Quran's guidance and proofs are part of God's guidance and proofs.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#5/r1.anchor: هذا الجار والمجرور صفة لقوله: " هدى وبينات " فمحله النصب، ويتعلق بمحذوف

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#5/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#5/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#5/r2.claim: الفرقان replaces البينات because it adds the sense of distinguishing truth from falsehood and echoes the preceding verse endings.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#5/r2.anchor: وعبر عن البينات بالفرقان ولم يأت " من الهدى والبينات " فيطابق العجز الصدر

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#5/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#5/r3.speaker: بعضهم
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#5/r3.claim: Some say the first هدى denotes the foundations of religion and the second its branches.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#5/r3.anchor: وقال بعضهم: " المراد بالهدى الأول أصول الديانات وبالثاني فروعها "

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#5/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#5/r4.speaker: ابن عطية
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#5/r4.claim: Ibn Atiyya treats the second الهدى as anaphoric to the first, citing the definite repetition pattern, Pharaoh's messenger, and Ibn Abbas's saying about one hardship and two eases.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#5/r4.anchor: وقال ابن عطية: " اللام في الهدى للعهد، والمراد الأول "

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#5/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#5/r5.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#5/r5.claim: The author rejects Ibn Atiyya's anaphoric reading: since هدى and بينات are حال, من الهدى cannot modify either or both without circularly qualifying the Quran by a part identical to the whole.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#5/r5.anchor: وما قاله ابن عطية لا يتأتى هنا، لأنه ذكر هو والمعربون أن " هدى " منصوب على الحال

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r1.claim: من الهدى cannot attach to بينات as a qualifier either: replacing الهدى by منه is invalid; the author therefore takes الهدى and الفرقان generally, with هدى وبينات a subset.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r1.anchor: فلذلك اخترنا أن يكون الهدى والفرقان عامين حتى يكون هدى وبينات بعضا منهما

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r2.claim: من in فمن شهد may be relative or conditional; the conditional parse is more apparent.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r2.anchor: " من " فيها الوجهان: أعني كونها موصولة أو شرطية، وهو الأظهر

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r3.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r3.claim: منكم is a حال of the implicit subject of شهد, governed by an omitted كائنا.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r3.anchor: و " منكم " في محل نصب على الحال من الضمير المستكن في " شهد "

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r4.speaker: أبو البقاء
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r4.claim: Abu al-Baqa calls منكم a حال of the subject and also attaches it to شهد; the author calls that contradictory, but allows semantic attachment through كائنا.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r4.anchor: وقال أبو البقاء: " منكم " حال من الفاعل، وهي متعلقة بـ " شهد "

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r5.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r5.claim: One parse makes الشهر an adverb: شهد means 'was present', with an omitted object such as the city.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r5.anchor: أحدهما: أنه منصوب على الظرف، والمراد بشهد: حضر

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r6.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r6.claim: The preferred direct-object parse estimates دخول الشهر; هلال الشهر is weak because Arabic says شاهدت الهلال, and it would wrongly require everyone seeing the crescent to fast.

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r7.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r7.speaker: الزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r7.claim: Al-Zamakhshari parses الشهر and the pronoun in فليصمه as adverbs because residents and travelers both witness the month; the author objects that verbs do not govern adverb pronouns without في unless broadened to object-case.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r7.anchor: وقال الزمخشري: " الشهر منصوب على الظرف، وكذلك الهاء في " فليصمه "

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r8.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r8.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r8.claim: فاء may mark the conditional answer or be extra in a predicate after relative من; the لام is imperative.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r8.anchor: إما جوب الشرط، وإما زائدة في الخبر على حسب ما تقدم

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r9.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r9.speaker: الجمهور
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r9.claim: The majority read the imperative لام with sukun, analogizing its position after واو or فاء to the connected form كتف.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r9.anchor: وقرأ الجمهور بسكونها وإن كان أصلها الكسر، وإنما سكنوها تشبيها لها مع الواو والفاء

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r10.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r10.speaker: السلمي وأبو حيوة
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r10.claim: Al-Sulami, Abu Haywa, and others preserve the original kasra of the imperative لام throughout the Quran.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r10.anchor: وقرأ السلمي وأبو حيوة وغيرهما بالأصل، أعني كسر لام الأمر في جميع القرآن

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r11.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r11.speaker: الفراء
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r11.claim: Farra reports that opening the imperative لام is a Sulaym dialect; some restrict it to cases where the following ya is open.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#6/r11.anchor: وفتح هذه اللام لغة سليم فيما حكاه الفراء

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#7/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#7/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#7/r1.claim: The definite article in الشهر is anaphoric; a pronoun could replace it, but the noun is expressed overtly to honor the month.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#7/r1.anchor: والألف واللام في قوله { فمن شهد منكم الشهر } للعهد إذ لو أتى بدله بضمير

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#7/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#7/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#7/r2.claim: The author refers the meaning and derivation of يريد to his discussion at 2:26.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#7/r2.anchor: تقدم معنى الإرادة واشتقاقها عند قوله تعالى: ماذا أراد الله بهذا

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#7/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#7/r3.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#7/r3.claim: اراد usually takes concrete objects with باء and verbal nouns directly, though the pattern can reverse; the poetic witness has أرادت عرارا بالهوان.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#7/r3.anchor: إلى المصادر بنفسه كالآية الكريمة، وقد ينعكس الأمر، قال الشاعر

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#7/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#7/r4.speaker: أبو البقاء
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#7/r4.claim: Abu al-Baqa reads باء as attachment: God figuratively attaches ease to you through allowing breaking the fast when excused.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#7/r4.anchor: قال أبو البقاء: " للإلصاق، أي: يلصق بكم اليسر وهو من مجاز الكلام

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#7/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#7/r5.speaker: أبو البقاء
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#7/r5.claim: Abu al-Baqa calls the denial of hardship emphatic, since saying God wills ease would suffice.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#7/r5.anchor: وفي قوله: { ولا يريد بكم العسر } تأكيد، لأن قبله { يريد الله بكم اليسر }

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#7/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#7/r6.speaker: أبو جعفر ويحيى بن وثاب وابن هرمز
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#7/r6.claim: Abu Ja'far, Yahya ibn Waththab, and Ibn Hurmuz read yusr and ʿusr with damma on sīn; grammarians differ on original damma versus assimilation, and the author prefers damma as customary.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#7/r6.anchor: وقرأ أبو جعفر ويحيى بن وثاب وابن هرمز: " اليسر والعسر " بضم السين

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r1.speaker: ابن عطية والزمخشري وأبو البقاء
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r1.claim: One view makes لام extra before implied أن, with ولتكملوا coordinated to اليسر as object; the long separation weakens the verb's governance, so لام restores it.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r1.anchor: كالتي في قولك: ضربت لزيد، و " أن " مقدرة بعدها

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r2.speaker: أبو صخر
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r2.claim: Abu Sakhr's أريد لأنسى حبها illustrates the extra لام construction.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r2.anchor:
ونحوه قول أبي صخر:
850 أريد لأنسى حبها فكأنما
تمثل لي ليلى بكل طريق

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r3.speaker: الفراء
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r3.claim: Al-Farra takes the لام as causal and supplies a deleted verb after واو: ولتكملوا العدة فعل هذا.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r3.anchor: وهو المعلل تقديره: " ولتكملوا العدة فعل هذا " ، وهو قول الفراء

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r4.speaker: الزجاج
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r4.claim: Al-Zajjaj coordinates it with an omitted cause and omits its consequence: فعل الله ذلك ليسهل عليكم ولتكملوا.

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r5.speaker: ابن عطية
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r5.claim: A view attributed by Ibn Atiyya to some Kufans estimates the explained action after the causal phrase: رخص لكم في ذلك.

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r6.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r6.claim: One proposed analysis makes واو extra, yielding يريد الله بكم كذا لتكملوا; the author calls it very weak.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r6.anchor: أن الواو زائدة تقديره: يريد الله بكم كذا لتكملوا، وهذا ضعيف جدا

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r7.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r7.speaker: الزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r7.claim: Al-Zamakhshari estimates شرع ذلك after ولعلكم تشكرون: completing the count explains the make-up command, magnifying explains the prescribed discharge, and gratitude explains the concession; he calls this a subtle لف.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r7.anchor: قاله الزمخشري، وهذا نص كلامه قال: " شرع ذلك، يعني جملة ما ذكر من أمر الشاهد بصوم الشهر

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r8.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r8.speaker: الزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r8.claim: Al-Zamakhshari also coordinates ولتكملوا with an omitted cause لتعملوا ما تعلمون; the cause explained is God's willing ease.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r8.anchor: أن تكون الواو عاطفة على علة محذوفة، التقدير: لتعملوا ما تعلمون ولتكملوا، قاله الزمخشري

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r9.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r9.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r9.claim: In summary, the causal لام may attach to a deleted action before or after it, or directly to يريد.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#8/r9.anchor: واختصار هذه الأوجه أن تكون هذه اللام علة لمحذوف: إما قبلها وإما بعدها

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r1.speaker: ابن عطية
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r1.claim: Ibn Atiyya's third view makes the لام imperative, with واو coordinating an imperative sentence to a declarative one.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r1.anchor: الثالث: أنها لام الأمر، وتكون الواو قد عطفت جملة أمرية على جملة خبرية

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r2.claim: The author weakens the imperative parse: second-person المضارع with لام is rare, and unanimous kasra reading is notable because an imperative لام permits kasra or sukun.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r2.anchor: أحدهما: أن أمر المخاطب بالمضارع مع لامه لغة قليلة نحو: لتقم يا زيد

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r3.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r3.claim: The rare reading of Yunus 10:58 has فليفرحوا with second-person تاء, an example of the uncommon addressed imperative construction.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r3.anchor: وقد قرىء شاذا: { فبذلك فليفرحوا } [يونس: 58] بتاء الخطاب

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r4.speaker: الجمهور
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r4.claim: The majority read ولتكملوا with a light ميم, from أكمل; its hamza is causative.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r4.anchor: وقرأ الجمهور " ولتكملوا " مخففا من أكمل، والهمزة فيه للتعدية

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r5.speaker: أبو بكر
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r5.claim: Abu Bakr reads the ميم doubled; doubling and hamza generally alternate in causative function.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r5.anchor: وقرأ أبو بكر بتشديد الميم، والتضعيف للتعدية أيضا

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r6.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r6.claim: العدة's article most likely refers back to فعدة من أيام أخر at 2:184; alternatively it is generic, requiring Ramadan's full count, whether 29 or 30 days.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r6.anchor: والألف واللام في " العدة " تحتمل وجهين أحدهما: أنها للعهد فيكون ذلك راجعا إلى قوله تعالى

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r7.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r7.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r7.claim: ولتكبروا has the same range of لام analyses as ولتكملوا, except the fourth analysis does not apply here.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#9/r7.anchor: فالكلام فيها كالكلام فيها، إلا أن القول الربع لا يتأتى هنا

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#10/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#10/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#10/r1.claim: على ما هداكم is governed by تكبروا. على retains its ordinary sense of elevation because تكبير incorporates the sense of praising God.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#10/r1.anchor: وإنما تعدى فعل التكبير بها لتضمنه معنى الحمد

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#10/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#10/r2.speaker: الشيخ
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#10/r2.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī paraphrases this as magnifying God while praising Him; the Shaykh says this explains meaning, not syntax, since على would then modify the implied حامدين.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#10/r2.anchor: قال الشيخ: " وهذا منه تفسير معنى لا إعراب، إذ لو كان كذلك لكان تعلق "

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#10/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#10/r3.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#10/r3.claim: The alternative takes على as لام التعليل; the author prefers its ordinary sense because figurative use of a preposition is weak.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#10/r3.anchor: والثاني: أنها بمعنى لام العلة، والأول أولى لأن المجاز في الحرف ضعيف

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#10/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#10/r4.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#10/r4.claim: ما is most clearly a verbal noun, meaning His guidance of you; the alternative makes it a relative pronoun and needs an omitted object pronoun and an omitted noun such as following.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#10/r4.anchor: أظهرهما: أنها مصدرية، أي: على هدايته إياكم. والثاني: أنها بمعنى الذي

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#10/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#10/r5.speaker: الشيخ
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#10/r5.claim: The relative-pronoun parse is remote: it deletes the object هداكموه and needs an omitted noun to yield the sense following what guided you.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#10/r5.anchor: قال الشيخ: " وفيه بعد من وجهين، أحدهما: حذف العائد تقديره: هداكموه "

SAMIN-DURR:2:185#10/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#10/r6.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#10/r6.claim: The verse closes with hope of gratitude because it follows ease and legal concession; the preceding difficult duties end with hope of piety. The pattern is concessions followed by thanks, unreduced burdens by piety.
SAMIN-DURR:2:185#10/r6.anchor: وختمت هذه الآية بترجي الشكر لأن قبلها تيسيرا وترخيصا، فناسب ختمها بذلك

ZAJJAJ:v1p253/r1.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v1p253/r1.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v1p253/r1.claim: The nominative reading is used; accusative is also allowed but is less common.
ZAJJAJ:v1p253/r1.anchor: القراءة بالرفع ويجوز النصب، وهي قراءة ليست بالكثيرة

ZAJJAJ:v1p253/r2.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v1p253/r2.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v1p253/r2.claim: For the nominative, three parses are possible: a fresh statement with an understood ‘fasting/days prescribed’; apposition to fasting in the passive; or an initial topic whose predicate is ‘in which the Qur’an was sent down.’
ZAJJAJ:v1p253/r2.anchor: ورفعه على ثلاثة أضرب: أحدها الاستئناف.

ZAJJAJ:v1p253/r3.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v1p253/r3.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v1p253/r3.claim: The accusative has two parses: apposition to ‘numbered days,’ or an exhortative command meaning ‘adhere to Ramadan.’
ZAJJAJ:v1p253/r3.anchor: ومن نصب شهر رمضان نصبه على وجهين، أحدهما أن يكون بدلا من أيام معدودات. والوجه الثاني على الأمر

ZAJJAJ:v1p253/r4.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v1p253/r4.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v1p253/r4.claim: Whoever is present rather than traveling must fast; the sick and travelers may make up the corresponding days later.
ZAJJAJ:v1p253/r4.anchor: ومعنى من شهد: من كان شاهدا غير مسافر فليصم، ومن كان مسافرا أو مريضا فقد جعل له أن يصوم

ASAD-NOTES:2:185#n158/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:2:185#n158/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:2:185#n158/r1.claim: The phrase literally means “witnesses” or “is present in,” explaining Asad’s rendering “lives to see” the month.

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p1041/r1.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p1041/r1.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p1041/r1.claim: بهيمة الأنعام exemplifies adding a general noun to a specific one, as in شهر رمضان; the construction appears in Arabic and in the Qur’an.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p1041/r1.anchor: بهمية الأنعام إضافة العام (البهيمة) إلى الخاص (الأنعام) كما نقول يوم الخميس

FARISI-HUJJA:v2p248#2/r1.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v2p248#2/r1.speaker: author
FARISI-HUJJA:v2p248#2/r1.claim: The command فليصمه is understood by analogy with the preceding construction as an obligation, just as the prior phrase means that women should wait.
FARISI-HUJJA:v2p248#2/r1.anchor: فمن شهد منكم الشهر فليصمه [البقرة/ 185] قياسه على ما تقدم

FARISI-HUJJA:v2p274/r1.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v2p274/r1.speaker: عاصم في رواية أبي بكر
FARISI-HUJJA:v2p274/r1.claim: Abū Bakr’s transmission from ʿĀṣim reads the mīm geminated.
FARISI-HUJJA:v2p274/r1.anchor: قرأ عاصم في رواية أبي بكر ولتكملوا العدة مشددة

FARISI-HUJJA:v2p274/r2.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v2p274/r2.speaker: حفص عن عاصم
FARISI-HUJJA:v2p274/r2.claim: Ḥafṣ transmits the light mīm reading from ʿĀṣim.
FARISI-HUJJA:v2p274/r2.anchor: وروى حفص عن عاصم ولتكملوا خفيفة

FARISI-HUJJA:v2p274/r3.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
